Qt for Python (PySide6, shiboken6) and Qt
==========================================

The FFIX Save Converter desktop application uses Qt for Python (PySide6 and shiboken6, version 6.12.0) and the Qt 6
libraries they ship with (Qt Core, Qt Gui, Qt Widgets and their Windows platform and style plugins).

Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.

These components are used under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3 (LGPL-3.0). The license texts are in
this folder: LGPL-3.0.txt, and GPL-3.0.txt (which the LGPL-3.0 incorporates by reference).

The Qt and PySide6 libraries are included unmodified, as separate files in the _internal\PySide6 and
_internal\shiboken6 folders next to the program. You may replace them with your own compatible builds of the same
version (6.12.x). The FFIX Save Converter itself is MIT-licensed and does not restrict that.

Source code for these components:
  Qt for Python:  https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git (tag v6.12.0)
                  https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/
  Qt:             https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qt5.git and https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/
